help.faq10a: A small platform fee is deducted from each rental to cover payment processing, insurance, and platform operations. The exact percentage is shown before you confirm a booking.
help.faq1a: Browse listings, select an item, choose your rental dates, and send a booking request. The owner will review and approve your request. Once approved, you can proceed with payment.
help.faq1q: How do I rent an item?
help.faq2a: Go to your Profile and click 'List an Item'. Fill in the details including photos, description, pricing, and availability. Submit for review and once approved, your item will be visible in search results.
help.faq2q: How do I list an item for rent?
help.faq3a: Rentals are paid through our secure payment gateway (ToyyibPay). Payment is collected upfront before the rental period begins. Owners receive payouts after the rental is completed and confirmed.
help.faq4a: We verify your identity through document upload (MyKad/Passport) combined with a selfie or video liveness check. Higher verification levels unlock premium features and build trust with the community.
help.faq5a: Go to your Dashboard, find the rental, and use the cancel option. Cancellation policies vary — please check the specific listing's terms. Contact support if you have issues.
help.faq5q: How do I cancel a booking?
help.faq6a: Inspect the item at handover and report any issues immediately. Our dispute resolution team can help if there's a disagreement. Always take photos during handover and return.
help.faq6q: What if an item is damaged?
help.faq7a: You can reach us via the contact form below or email support@renty.my. We aim to respond within 24 hours during business days.
help.faq8a: Yes. We use industry-standard encryption, secure authentication, and never share your data with third parties. See our Privacy Policy for details.
help.faq9a: Complete the vendor onboarding process from your profile. You'll need to provide business details and verify your identity. Approved vendors can list multiple items and access analytics.
help.faq9q: How do I become a vendor?
help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions
help.title: Help Center

rentalAgreement.acceptanceNote: By booking, the Renter agreed to these terms. The Vendor agreed by approving the booking.
rentalAgreement.agreeToTermsLabel: I have read and accept the Rental Agreement
rentalAgreement.clause1: Renty is a facilitator platform only and is not a party to this rental contract. The contract is between the Vendor and the Renter.
rentalAgreement.clause2: The Renter must use the item with reasonable care and in accordance with the item description and any usage guidelines.
rentalAgreement.clause3: The item must be returned on the end date in the same condition as received, normal wear and tear excepted.
rentalAgreement.clause4: The Renter is responsible for damage or loss beyond normal wear and tear and may be charged from the security deposit or through the dispute process.
rentalAgreement.clause5: Late return may incur additional daily charges at the agreed rental rate and may affect the Renter's RentyScore.
rentalAgreement.clause6: The security deposit is refunded after the return inspection, less any deductions for damage or unpaid charges.
rentalAgreement.clause7: If the Vendor rejects a booking, the Renter receives a full refund. Cancellations follow the platform refund policy.
rentalAgreement.clause8: Unresolved issues are handled through the platform's dispute process. Personal data is processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy.
rentalAgreement.denied: You do not have access to this agreement
rentalAgreement.subtitle: Binding agreement between the item owner (Vendor) and the renter (Renter) for this rental.
